Fixes `bypassPermissions` ("Bypass all") still prompting or canceling tool calls over ACP, background task cancellation races misreporting red errors and wiping logs, and Update page version desync caused by silent in-place `agy` self-updates.

## Bypass Permissions & Background Task Cancellation Fixes

- **True `bypassPermissions` enforcement on `agy acp`**: Because `agy acp` `session/set_mode` only accepts `default` / `accept-edits` / `plan`, selecting "Bypass all" previously fell back to `accept-edits`, still prompting on `run_command` and failing with `Tool execution was canceled` on timeout. When no `disallowedTools` are configured, `acp.mjs` now launches `agy acp` with `--dangerously-skip-permissions` and `--add-dir`, always forwards `additionalDirectories` on `session/new` and `session/resume`, immediately evicts skip-permission workers upon mid-turn or global permission downgrade, and preserves the active permission badge across frontend state syncs.
- **Background task cancel race & live progress**: Reconciles `agy`'s signal-termination sequence (`failed` before `stopReason: "cancelled"`), preserves accumulated `task-<N>.log` output instead of overwriting it, and restores `cancelled` status consistently across live cards and `.jsonl` history reloads; adds live phase heartbeats while awaiting long-running background commands.

## End-to-End Update & Version Alignment

- **Lock out silent in-place `agy` self-updates**: Sets `AGY_CLI_DISABLE_AUTO_UPDATE=1` across gateway and terminal wrappers (`agy` ignores `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC`) so background runs can no longer overwrite versioned directories in place or break `manifest.json` `sha256` seals; routes bare `agy update` in the terminal through `install-agy.mjs` atomic symlink updates.
- **Binary version probing, offline local version switching & pool eviction**: `install-agy.mjs` and `Updater.java` now verify binary existence and probe `agy --version` directly; `--recheck` migrates and cleans up historically self-updated directories, `/api/claude/versions` filters out drifted folders, pinning switches verified local versions offline and rolls back preferences on failure, and `ACP_POOL` keys now hash `realpath + inode + size + mtime` so updated `agy` binaries take effect on the very next turn across Chat, Capabilities, Diagnostics, and Changelog views. Also re-signs `verified.json.sig`.

## Notes

- Gateway/frontend test suites, Java host compilation, and all 9 language dictionaries (3,174 entries) pass verification.
- Upgrading does not touch existing sessions, settings, or archives.

Closes ACP ghost subagents and background wakeup state-machine gaps end-to-end, while landing full security-pipeline parity, pool isolation, unattended permission boundaries, and targetSdk 36 host self-healing.

## ACP Background Wakeup, Subagent Lifecycle & State Machine

- **Deterministic background shell attribution & auto-wakeup**: Non-daemon background shells bind uniquely to `pid:starttime` via incremental child snapshots (fail-closed on ambiguity), verify `/proc/<pid>/stat` field-22 `starttime` against PID reuse before falling back to `kill(pid, 0)` under `hidepid=2`, prune only exited shells when sibling tasks remain alive, and trigger a single wakeup after a 15-second quiet grace window.
- **Ghost subagent elimination**: Unified `manage_subagents(list)` reconciliation, symmetric `send_message` re-activation (clearing stale sender state), `[Message] … sender=` envelope extraction, and 32 KiB last-turn transcript settlement so completed subagents never linger in the top running badge.
- **Idle-burst mutex, split-brain prevention & multi-step text**: Active `idleBurst` turns now guard the send queue as well as fork, delete-message, undo, move, and trash operations; 10-second `forceEnd` synchronously persists partial turns before destroying hung clients to prevent dual-process split-brain and interleaved `.jsonl` writes; preserved post-tool `agent_message` / `agent_thought` segments without duplicating ID-less chunk streams; closed pooled sessions on lifecycle edits and purged `brain/<uuid>` on permanent trash deletion.

## Security Pipeline, Pool Isolation, Schedules & Multimodal

- **ACP security gates & built-in Device MCP**: Added `O_NOFOLLOW` binary seal checks, `collectAddDirs` private-path filtering, `<system-reminder>` marker neutralization on both user input and expanded custom commands, first-turn auto-titling, archive reference injection, and built-in Device MCP support launched via `linker64` under targetSdk 36 with `CCAPP_PRIV_SESS` pool session witnessing.
- **Full pool fingerprinting & unattended permission safety**: Included endpoint, proxy, `extraEnv`, `extraModels`, `addDirs`, and `mcpServers` hashes in `poolKey` and serialized cold-start `settings.json` sync across concurrent heterogeneous sessions; prevented scoped `allowedTools` rules (such as `Bash(git status:*)`) from widening into blanket tool-group approval in unattended turns, blocked silent `allow_always` escalation in scheduled runs, and enforced fail-closed mode clamping for `disallowedTools` (including `WebFetch` and `WebSearch` without affecting local `grep_search`); enabled inline images across all 5 ACP presets with `@"/path/with space.png"` support.

## Update Checks, targetSdk 36 Host & UI Polish

- **Read-only update checks & CLI verification**: Synced read-only `upd_status`, 10-minute foreground check throttling, `noticeHold` release, `.agy-uninstalled` recognition, and `install-agy.mjs` version validation.
- **Host & SPA improvements**: Synced alignment-safe `exec-shim.c` `newfstatat`, in-destination archive staging with 256 MB timeout-free large-archive extraction/preview, atomic `AppFiles.ensureSynced` upgrade locking, `.gateway.pid` reaping, the read-only project memory viewer, long-path `encodeProjectDir` hashing, on-demand lineage `map.js` loading, and live `acpBg` sidebar indicators.
